description.text: Based on a strong educational and research tradition in finance, Antai 's MBA in finance is designed to help finance professionals increase their competitiveness and gain an edge in the global marketplace. The MBA in Finance aims to cultivate talents in international finance, preparing students for future managerial roles in finance and investment. The program offers curriculum adopted from the courses of famous international universities and meets the requirements of the CFA examination. This program is a part-time 2 ½ year program taught in Chinese. MBA in Finance Features 1. Includes MBA degree and completion of CFA examination. 2. Curriculum emphasis on knowledge and skills in finance and investment. 3. Core courses taught with international teaching materials. 4. Professors are proficient in both academic research and industry developments and practices. 5. The Financial MBA Forum regularly invites experienced and successful finance professionals for informational exchanges and lectures. Time Schedule 18:30-22:00 Tuesdays and Thursdays, 8:30-12:00 and 13:00-18:00 Saturdays.During the fourth semester, classes are held on one day only, either Saturday or Sunday. The dissertation is written during the fifth semester.

duration.text: The MBA in Finance at Shanghai JiaoTong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 10444 USD/In total ￥ 75200 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency. 8.Proof of remittance of application fee 9.Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: 1.Be in good health and over 18 years in age 2.An accredited bachelor's degree plus 3 years full-time work experience, or an associate's degree plus 5 years full-time work experience 3.Recommendation from at least two teachers with titles of or above associate-professor 4.A minimum requirement of HSK 6 certificate to prove your Chinese language ability
